# Your account

- Route: `/account`

## Summary

The signed-in account screen: usage today, history of results, saved projects (Darkroom, Motion, Aperture), saved voices, billing, privacy & data (how long files are kept, export or delete everything) and profile. Tabs are addressed with ?tab=.
